notes.title: Shadow Strikers Live Showcase: Exclusive Gameplay and Developer Insights
notes.notes:
Welcome to the 'Shadow Strikers Live Showcase,' a special event as part of Steam Next Fest! Dive into the captivating 3D fighting game set in the enigmatic city of Shadow Waven. Join Erasmo Mutemba, the solo developer behind 'Shadow Strikers,' as he takes you on a journey through the shadowy streets and introduces you to the diverse characters and organizations competing in the tournament.

During this live showcase, you'll have the opportunity to:

    Witness exclusive gameplay footage
    Gain insights into the game's development process
    Learn about the unique features that set 'Shadow Strikers' apart
    Participate in a live Q&A session with the developer
    Get a sneak peek at upcoming updates and content

Whether you're a gaming enthusiast, a fan of fighting games, or curious about the development journey, this event promises an engaging experience. Mark your calendars, bring your questions, and join us for an unforgettable exploration of 'Shadow Strikers.
